note: KREG-001 AC-3 (aprender#4539, OBS-15 #4574), RATCHET per cop ruling 2026-09-27 13:13Z: a registry row is admitted with a per-arch parity receipt from a host whose arch equals the row's arch (any host for an arch=any row). Until 0.73 the rows without one are counted and that count must equal unreceipted_max; lower unreceipted_max when you add a receipt, never raise it. From version 0.73.0 unreceipted_max must be 0 (hard RED). Checked by realizar::kernel_registry tests (FALSIFY-KREG-008).
